List pixels#

get/v1/projects/{id}/pixels

List pixels belonging to the project. Required permission: pixel.list.

Parâmetros de caminho

idstring (uuid)obrigatório

Parâmetros de consulta

pageinteger

Padrão: 1

limitinteger

Padrão: 20

Exemplo
curl -X GET "https://api.trackup.me/v1/projects/{id}/pixels" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: $TRACKUP_API_KEY"
Respostas
200object

Successful response.

Create a pixel#

post/v1/projects/{id}/pixels

Create a pixel belonging to the project. Required permission: pixel.create.

Parâmetros de caminho

idstring (uuid)obrigatório

Corpo da requisição

object | object | object | object

Exemplo
curl -X POST "https://api.trackup.me/v1/projects/{id}/pixels" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: $TRACKUP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "name": "string",
  "type": "string",
  "config": {
    "pixelId": "string",
    "accessToken": "string"
  }
}'
Respostas

Created successfully.
